candidates.name: ratatui-explorer
candidates.assessment: Focused native navigation/input and renderable widget, theme/title hooks, filter/map callback, native path identity, no write commands. Parent preference; guard failed directory entry.

candidates.name: tui-file-explorer
candidates.assessment: Native search/sort and injectable FileSystem with semantic commands; library-only build available. Current published renderer has arbitrary UTF-8 byte slicing for a long current_dir header and less flexible header branding; needs correction or justified workaround.

candidates.name: ratatui-interact
candidates.assessment: Ready FileExplorerState/FileExplorer, search/multiselect and optional filesystem loading, but caller wires keyboard dispatch; navigation helpers discard load errors and the package brings a wider toolkit.
